purpose: Envelope discrimination expressed causally: the canonical hull rolls A->(7,95.5) -> (20,96) -> (45,92). The t=45 bar high pierces the A->(20,96) line beyond eps=0.005 — which is exactly the spec §8 worked example rejecting (20,96) — and (70,80) never reaches the line, so it is never selected. No breakout at any eps_break.

params.eps_break_note: eps=0.005 is used here to match the spec §8 worked example exactly. eps_break is illustrative, not locked (HD-03, §13.5); versioned/backtestable. This fixture is verified robust across an eps_break sweep — see causal_record.eps_break_robustness.
params.formation_params_note: Formation gates are first-class, k-independent, versioned parameters (§21.3, D-TL-12): min_formation_bars replaces the pivot-derived 2k+2 and min_ath_age_bars replaces the k-recency window. Numerically unchanged at k=3.

expected_second_anchor.reason: As-of-time all-highs upper-log-hull vertex of the line in force after the final bar (Lambda_n, §21.1): the shallowest descending line from A that dominates every bar high seen so far, within eps. Candidacy is over EVERY later bar high (§6, HD-11); pivot status is never consulted.

rejection_rationale.rejected_because: No daily close exceeds the line active at the start of its own bar by more than eps_break, at any bar.

Formation eligibility is evaluated as-of-time on the available prefix (§21.3): the line becomes ACTIVE only at the first bar satisfying |S_t| >= min_formation_bars AND tA <= (t-1) - min_ath_age_bars AND B*_t exists.

rejection_rationale.candidate: B=(6,95.5) as second anchor at the formation bar
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: It is not the shallowest envelope-valid descending candidate over the available prefix; the upper log-hull selects the maximum-slope valid candidate (§8, D-TL-04).
rejection_rationale.numeric: slope(A,(6,95.5)) = -0.00767399 < slope(A,B*) = -0.00657771; B* dominates every bar high in S_8 = bars 0..7 (worst gap 0 <= eps).

key_inequalities: Candidacy is over ALL later bar highs (§6, D-TL-05, HD-11) — never a pivot subset — and every value below is computed from bars strictly EARLIER than the bar it judges (§21.1, HD-12).
Formation (§21.3): t_form = 8 — the first bar with |S_t| >= min_formation_bars = 8 and tA <= (t-1) - min_ath_age_bars = (t-1) - 3 and an envelope-valid B*_t.

Pre-breakout re-selection (§21.6, §21.4 Lemma): B* re-binds exactly when a bar high reaches the active line, and the new line is effective from the NEXT bar — B* 7->20 effective t=21; B* 20->45 effective t=46.
Wick-break (§14): at t=20, ln(H)=4.56435 exceeds y_hat_20(20)=4.47362 by 0.0907321 > eps=0.005, while ln(C) is -0.0292688 relative to line+eps_break -> close does NOT confirm, state stays ACTIVE.
Wick-break (§14): at t=45, ln(H)=4.52179 exceeds y_hat_45(45)=4.51332 by 0.00846788 > eps=0.005, while ln(C) is -0.023511 relative to line+eps_break -> close does NOT confirm, state stays ACTIVE.
Governing line: A=(0,100), B*=(45,92), m=-0.00185292, b=4.60517 — the line in force after the final bar (Lambda_n).
geometry_check.notes: The spec §8 worked example is a STATIC hull comparison. Under HD-12 the same discrimination appears as a sequence of causal re-selections, and it terminates at the same canonical anchor B*=(45,92) with the same slope. eps=0.005 is retained to match the worked example.

causal_record.semantics: As-of-time (rolling causal) evaluation per §21 / HD-12 / D-TL-11. Every value below is derived ONLY from bars strictly earlier than the bar it judges; no expectation here uses a full-series hull.

formation.rule: FORMATION_ELIGIBLE(t) iff |S_t| >= min_formation_bars (F1) AND tA <= (t-1) - min_ath_age_bars (F2) AND B*_t exists (F3). Both thresholds are first-class versioned parameters, independent of the pivot window k (§21.3, D-TL-12).

as_of_time_candidate_set.note: Candidacy is over EVERY later bar high (§6, HD-11); pivot status is not consulted. Domination is tested over all bar highs in the prefix (D-TL-05).

pivot_context.definition: isPivotHigh(p,k): strict > against the k bars on the left, >= against the k bars on the right (§5).
pivot_context.note: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Pivot status is non-authoritative (§5, D-TL-03, HD-11): it never removes a candidate from §6/§8, never changes B*, and never affects formation eligibility (§21.3, D-TL-12). Replacing k here changes nothing in this fixture except this block.

non_retroactive_challengers.note: No later high has a shallower slope than the governing line; nothing could have re-selected B* even under a full-series reading.
